newWork.noTypes: The run reads this endpoint's published types. Choose an endpoint that publishes at least one type.

access.title: Agent access
access.lead: What an agent run you start may do: the profile's grant and your own permission, per operation. A run gets only what both allow.
access.readOnlyDefault: The profile declares no access, so its agents may use read-only operations only.
access.caption: Operations of {name}
access.blockHint: operations, kinds with read or propose, endpoints with read or write. Empty removes the block. The edit is a change an approver reviews.

activity.title: Activity
activity.lead: What is happening in this project: the reconciler, the pipelines, the gateway, the broker and the catalogue, newest first.
activity.panelEmpty: Nothing has happened to this one yet.
activity.announce: {count, plural, one {# new error} other {# new errors}}
activity.lastHour: What happened in the last hour

import.title: Import configuration
import.lead: A bundle another instance exported, read into this project as one change everybody can review.
import.fileHelp: A ZIP an export produced, or a YAML stream or JSON manifest.
import.noUrl: A bundle is uploaded, not fetched: importing from a URL would have this Portal open a connection to a host you name, and the policy that decides which hosts is not written yet (MF-20).
import.pastedSecret: This bundle writes a credential in the open ({keys}). Replace it with a secretRef and choose the file again; the import refuses it either way (MF-24).
import.namespaceHelp: Every imported manifest is rewritten into it.
import.orgDomainHelp: Every imported id is rewritten to it.
import.policy: A resource this project already has

policyHelp.fail: Nothing is imported if one name is taken, so nothing is decided by accident.
policyHelp.skip: What this project has stays; the rest is imported.
policyHelp.replace: The bundle's version wins for every name both hold.
policyHelp.rename: Both are kept and the imported one gets a free name.

import.checkFirst: Check the bundle to see what it would do.

report.title: What this import would do
report.lane: The whole bundle lands in the {lane} lane, the riskiest thing it carries.
report.verified: {equal} of {total} files equal the checksum the bundle carries.
report.unverifiable: The bundle carries no checksums, so nothing here says the files are unchanged.
report.nothingToProvide: Nothing to provide: the bundle carries everything it needs.

modal.title: What changed in ‘{id}’

lead.modified: The space answers differently from what the repository declares. Revert writes the repository back; adopt proposes what is live as the declared value.
lead.missing: The repository declares this entity and the space does not hold it. Revert writes it back.

modal.noAdopt: There is nothing live to adopt: removing the entity from the repository is an explicit deletion, not a button.
modal.proposed: Proposed. An approver reviews it like any other change.
